policy: Precise false-positive exemptions for the Pre-Deploy Audit. Each entry exempts ONE specific (mpn, field, value) triple that is a REAL product specification, NOT test/synthetic/mock data. This file is auditable: every exemption must record reason + source. The audit only applies an exemption when ALL of (exact value, field name in match context, product identity) match. Adding a broad rule here (e.g. exempting a whole field/value family) is forbidden and will be rejected in review.
